1.heading: Emergency Water Shutdown
1.description: There will be a water shutdown on Monday due to main pipeline leakage repairs.

2.heading: Association Meeting
2.description: There will be an association meeting at the community hall on 15-11-2026 at 6 PM. Concerned people should come on time.

3.heading: Mosquito Fogging Schedule
3.description: Routine mosquito fogging will be carried out across all blocks this Friday evening. Please keep your windows closed between 5 PM and 7 PM.

4.heading: Lift Maintenance - Block B
4.description: The service lift in Block B will be non-operational for scheduled servicing on 13-11-2026 from 10 AM to 2 PM.

5.heading: Mandatory ID Updates for Domestic Help
5.description: All residents must submit updated Aadhaar copies for their maids, drivers, and cooks to the security office by 20-11-2026.

CMP-001.title: Low water pressure in master bathroom
CMP-001.description: Water pressure dropped severely in the shower and basin since yesterday morning.

CMP-002.title: Corridor lights flickering in Block A 2nd floor
CMP-002.description: Two LED batten fixtures in the common hallway outside flat 203 keep buzzing and flashing.

CMP-003.title: Service elevator grinding noise between floors 3 and 4
CMP-003.description: Lift motor or guide rails make a severe screeching sound whenever ascending.

CMP-004.title: Garbage chute blocked near 4th floor
CMP-004.description: The waste chute door won't latch shut due to overflow bags trapped in the shaft.

CMP-005.title: Late night music on community terrace
CMP-005.description: Loud speakers and gathering noise past 11:30 PM on weekend evenings.
